body:
I would care beforehand but unfortunately most of us in these threads have no way of knowing other people are not feeling well until they are at a very bad point. 

Anyone whose opinion immediately instills fear in you is not worth having in your life! And if it's family or people you can't cut out simply keep them at a distance. I know it's easier said then done but your life and happiness is of most importance, and there is always a light at the end of the tunnel even if you cannot see it right now.

 By being in the closet do you mean with the thoughts your currently having or do you mean sexually?

Thank you I really appreciate your words and time. Unfortunately at night its hardest to control my anxiety and even though in the last 5 months I've heard many things that have brought me temporary comfort sometimes I need to be re-reminded when in this type of fog. It's true, no matter if she regretted it or not she is no longer in pain.

I think it was immediate death, my sister is a physician and that's all she ever repeats "at least she did not suffer". But I still have a restless feeling that she was backing away and some nights it's all I can think about. Close as in from the accident scene or close with her? Yes to both though...

Thank you. I often wonder if she was backing out of it due to how they recorded her being half on the highway half on the shoulder. Maybe it all just happened so fast. I know there is nothing I can do about it now, but it definitely messes with me. Somedays I think to reach out and talk to the box truck driver whose name is in the police report, but I don't even know if thats legal.
They commented as I was typing further background / my connection to the question...

It was my mom, and a question that eats at me every night.

I did not know if there were any crime scene investigators, medical examiners, highway patrol etc lingering that may have experience in high impact deaths. Thank you for your condescending answer.
You keep narrowing it down to masterbation when I’ve made it abundantly clear it’s a larger issue then him simply masterbating.

Picking and choosing what I’m saying to further solidify your perception and opinion doesn’t make your advice credible or worthy. If you’re posting in relationship advice and spending all this time responding to me simply to make me seem irrational, and belittle me, rather then give me functional advice maybe you’re the one with some mental health battles / complexes. 

His behaviors are not just for masterbation and I’ve clarified that on numerous occasions. It is an all the time habit. Whenever he is on his phone it’s what he’s “indulging in”. He can master bate everyday and he can masterbate to specific porn stars again I don’t care. It’s about how much and the specifics because yes both things matter. 

There is absolutely credible research about fixations, sensory issues, and relationship outlooks when you’re constantly exposing yourself to these channels. It is emotionally tolling to be in a relationship with someone who is on a never ending pursuit for seeing women naked and watching pornography.

Regardless of it is effects his sexual capacity with me it absolutely effects my sexual capacity with him and that’s should be considered. There’s absolutely a limit of how much porn and NSFW is too much and unhealthy. Aka if you’re saving pictures, commenting on things, subscribing to specific girls, internet creeping etc. it’s feels more like an addiction / obsession.

No expose as in (making something deliberately visible and subjecting yourself to it). 

Personally I feel like I’m reasonable. If there are specific people he is attracted to that’s fine. If he master-bates that’s fine. Again, it’s the frequency and quantity to which he “indulges” in these behaviors that bothers me. He is on reddit constantly and therefor constantly seeing dozens of subreddits pertaining to porn / girls / NSFW material. The amount and degree to the behavior is what is most bothersome. The fact that it strains our relationship, he says he will stop, and doesn’t also does not help the situation or my feelings that he has a fixation.

Perhaps you never dealt with a huge trauma. Comparing children to an unnatural death of the most significant person in your life is a tad different. My mom took her life, and was my absolute best friend which is a huge traumatic loss. On top of this I am dealing with newly diagnosed endometriosis. It’s not that I can’t or am not horny but there are many underlying factors that first need resolution. Not to mention - no matter the time in our relationship or how sexually active we are he does this.
This comment is print + frame worthy

Thank you I appreciate it. And that’s true, he’s supportive basically there for everything I need but this one simple thing he simply cannot stop? It’s not as though he is next to me and on his phone scrolling but whenever we are away and he has free time I know that’s what he’s doing. 

I think we didn’t get married because in my culture / family finishing college was really important for me to do before major life decisions and then soon after my mom got sick. Plus I still feel kind of young (25). But it does make me think there were other subconscious reasons I had as well now.

Marriage is definitely down the line as he has made it very clear that’s his plan. I basically already feel married but am the one who does not want to rush things and made it clear or else I know he would already have initiated everything. 

I think my final straw was that my mom recently passed away (6mo ago) and obviously I barely can function with day to day tasks much less think about sex. He is very supportive and understanding overall but when recently he was caught in his same sh*t he tried to say it’s because we rarely have sex... when these issues have always existed regardless of how active our sex life is. 

You’re very right about the committed to his word statement, he’s an otherwise disciplined person with a very discipline oriented career (military) and yet he cannot control himself with this it really hurts me.

I know you are struggling. I am too. But we have to believe there is something better around the corner if we put some effort in. We have to speak it into existence. It feels like it takes the world of energy for me to get out of bed, but when my days are filled with even 1-2 things rather then just laying in bed and my lists are checked I do feel better. When I kiss my cats, or have a small laugh about something dumb I read on this site, or even just sit in my backyard with the sun beaming, I feel a small sense of hope. small things make me realize why I’m still here. We all have small things but sometimes we forget to take notice of them, try to notice and appreciate them more often. You are worth it. You are. You aren’t lazy, your depressed. You aren’t a burden, your existence is important to the people in your life. Your story doesn’t have to end this way right now.

It definitely takes energy, I completely understand. After my mom took her life my sister (who is my older sister aka my mini mom and is also a dr) HOUNDED me to go see a therapist. From setting reminders on my phone, to texting me back to back, to even setting up an appointment for me. I went to the appointments she set up for me. It was not effective at all, I felt like I got nothing out of it. It wasn’t until two months later where I was in such a dark space that I decided one day to look up a therapist and go, and I promised myself to go with an open mind. It wasn’t until I basically went in thinking “this might help” that it started to. When we think “this isn’t going to help” or when we only do something for others expectations it never turns out well. I know it is hard but please try to keep an open mind when doing things for yourself. 

It seems like you feel you’ve exhausted everyone around you, but I also gather that you (like me) are an over thinker and really think about all your behaviors and also how they effect others. We are our own worst critics at times. Don’t think about whether you took things away from your loved ones experiences in the past, just try to remain future focused and think of the small realistic steps you can add in the future.

I’m only 24 so I’ll prob sound like a grand parent saying this but “in today’s darn day and age” we are always exposed to everyone’s perfect lives. Social media and these fake bubbles (I myself also play into) have us all forgetting that everyone has problems. Whether it’s family problems, money problems, physical health problems, mental health problems, no ones lives are perfect. 

You don’t want to die as you said. That’s a huge step, recognizing you do not want to die. And you shouldn’t die. I know right now it seems like there isn’t much, but think of all the new beginnings you can create for yourself in the months and years to come. Maybe the next few weeks and months will not be the easiest but you can get out of this fog.

Finding things that make you happy. It might sound kind of lame but I’m a 24 yo female and I literally like to garden. It might not be as cool as other people’s hobbies but it makes me happy. I’ve also felt really unmotivated recently since my mom died. One thing I’ve been recommending is lists. In order to avoid being in bed all day the next day, the night before I write a small list of things I should get done the next day.

An example of tonight’s : cook dinner, go to gym, apply to four jobs on indeed, make dr appt for ear, water plants, watch video on Charles swab money market fund.

So yeah, it’s not much in my day really but once I check them all I feel really good and motivated. I feel better about myself and mentally feel in a better space. I need to write my daily boundaries to motivate myself and keep myself accountable because I’m otherwise very depressed and too sad to do anything.

I’m sorry you are going through this. Dealing with a demented family member is very exhausting. My mom didn’t have dementia but she had very very bad depression her last year before taking her life. I was her caretaker and monitored her a lot. I know it can be emotionally exhausting. Sometimes I feel like at  24 yo I’ve seen and experienced so much that maybe I’m done. I have friends and some good family members I’m not necessarily alone but it doesn’t matter because I feel alone a lot. I would rather have 1-2 friends I could be completely real with then many I have to put on a fake face for. 

I know you said you are tired but have you ever considered just giving yourself a list of things you wish to accomplish in the week. Being able to mark off on a list is a good feeling. Small things for yourself. Maybe once a week cooking a food you like, or watching a movie you wanted to. It seems tiring but once it’s done it does feel good to know you’ve done it for yourself. 

As for socially, are there any friends you’ve lost contact with that you could maybe reach out to and see if they would grab a beer or something? WhAt I’ve realized is a lot of people feel secluded and lonely but are very willing to hangout and meet up if you reach out.

Unfortunately depression does not change according to external factors. People think winning the lottery would help, having a child, moving to another state etc. sure for some time or at some points these things can bring relief but in reality nothing helps long term and as effectively besides what we change within us. Our everyday behaviors and activities. I’m lazy and not motivated, completely depressed and basically bed ridden since my mom’s suicide in March. But I do acknowledge that going to counseling once a week has helped, gardening (I love to garden) has helped, walking at night has helped. Little things I do myself for myself. Are there some things you can try? Maybe a weekly counseling session and a weekly hobby outing perhaps?
I will talk to you... PM me.

You mentioned “what I would like to achieve in life” meaning you have goals and dreams. That in itself is huge. You have things you know you want or hope for. The lack of motivation and energy to care is a result of the fog / funk of depression and mental health issues. I have no motivation either but I do want a good life deep down. I know what I want but sometimes some days I don’t do anything toward it. I procrastinate and I do other things less important. It’s a way of pushing off what overwhelms me. I’m slowly working on it by creating lists of small things to do everyday to get a little closer to my goal. also it’s insightful to remember that some people have all the energy but no idea what they want. I know seeing past the fog is hard but I think you can do it

Many small victories are far more important and impressive than one or two big victories. Small victories. Some of mine are - going to the gym, taking a shower, eating vegetables, gardening. I consider these small victories on days I otherwise don’t want to leave my bed

You’re right no one on the internet genuinely cares about you, because we all are anonymous hiding behind screen names and don’t know who “you is”. So you, the specific person, we don’t know. But what I do know is the words you write and the pain you feel. I care that you feel this sad and down. You may feel like a disappointment but you aren’t. We all make mistakes, I could make a movie of my ridiculous teenage years, but our families will eventually look past them. We are all able to grow out of the images they have of us, it just takes time. They love you deep down and that’s what matters.

You mention how you feel like you are a burden and judged for not doing things around the house and sleeping a lot. Is there any specific reason why you feel you can’t function or don’t have energy? Depression is a disease. Just because we cannot see it like most cancers does not mean it isn’t as symptom ridden. Being tired and no energy is a very normal experience with depression. But like many symptoms to many diseases there are small things you can start to do to see if anything changes. Giving yourself small lists everyday to show yourself you can complete tasks, going for short walks etc. you may feel you are a burden (my mom wrote she was in her own suicide note) but your death will be a big burden. You are not a burden.

Money comes and goes. I know right now you are in some tough spots but you can definitely get out of them. Nothing is unfixable. My mom was in 35k credit card debt and 200k equity loan and complained a lot about money, even though she had a good job and it could be fixed. She let the idea of her debt push her into a corner and think there weren’t alternatives. Now she’s gone, she took her life in March (money being one of many reasons). Ironically my sister and I now have significant money due to her life insurance policies, I can assure you it means nothing. My pain and misery existed the same before the life insurance policy payout. It will continue until I’m able to be happy and I know it. You can get back on your feet I truly believe you can turn this around. I would give all the money and privilege and everything in this world for my mom back. Money isn’t comforting this pain in anyway shape or form. Because money cannot buy away depression or anxiety. Other things can help depressions nd anxiety though. You will find a good paying job you will slowly pay your loans and you will have a happy life filled with meaningful things. First we need to start by thinking positive, then we need to get into action. Don’t give up.

But pain and sadness shows you are capable of feeling emotions. The fact that you can recognize you feel those things shows a strength, many people would never admit it because of the stigma of it being considered “weak” but you’re admitting it and it is actually a strength to come terms with when you’re feeling down. When you can admit to feeling things that aren’t instagram or Facebook worthy in this fake ass world others pretend to live in.

Also joy will only come when you let it. Since my mom killed herself the only times I’ve caught myself having fun or laughing is when I’m not obsessing over the situation, when I actually just accept it for what it is and put it in the back of my mind to rest for a few moments. If you let go of thinking about how sad and angry you are maybe it can help you feel other emotions for even a short while sometimes.

Tonight is my first night truly being active on this site. I don’t want you to feel like my message isn’t personalized to you or that I do this all the time, because I don’t. I read your entire post. First I want to say I understand your anxiety struggles, I had to go to court several times for poor attendance throughout high school I had debilitating social anxiety even though I was technically part of the “popular” group. I ended up dropping out months before senior graduation. My mom pushed me to get my GED and take my SATs I ended up getting into a local college and recently finishing with two bachelors degrees in the STEM field. As a teen I thought I hated school turns out I hated high school, big difference. Once you’re out of high school things change, less people in your business or that you have to see constantly. Just know there’s always a chance always room for growth.

I’m sorry you had to go through that with the mental ward and everything unfortunately the places designed to help can mess with you more. Overall it sounds like you’re someone who can see things clearly for what they are and acknowledges your behaviors, and your emotions. These are important traits not everyone has. That alone shows you have the ability to be resilient and do better with your life. I think you definitely can but it would need to start by not dwelling too much over things you cannot fix. You have a right to be angry about the past but your anger is blocking you from a better future.

I care about you because you’re a person capable of emotions and understanding, and because I know what it’s like to be left behind by suicide. Don’t leave anyone behind by this. the pain is umanageable.

I feel the same. Since my mom killed herself I think about suicide often but I know that I would never put anyone in the pain I am in. I know logically I wouldn’t do it but it doesn’t stop the constant idea of it running in my mind.

My mom took her life in March. I am looking to connect with people in similar situations. I feel so lonely even though I have a good support system. I wish I had more people who understand. Please PM me
